title: Elasticsearch DSL Injection to Cross-Index Read
learning_objectives: Recognise NoSQL/query-DSL injection as the same class of flaw as classic SQLi
Spot an app that forwards a user-supplied JSON body verbatim into a search DSL

Widen the search scope via the JS object-spread precedence bug — a body-level `index` key sent to a search endpoint that does `search({index: 'logs', ...body})` overrides the intended scope and searches whatever index the caller chose
Understand Painless script_fields (and the sandbox limits that make cross-index reads via script alone infeasible in 8.x)
Reason about response filtering: script_fields returns fields the app did not select for
flag_hint: Widen the app's search scope to reach the hidden .credentials index, extract secret_key for doc id 'flag', then POST /solve {"secret_key":"<value>"} to receive the flag.
inspired_by: The 2020 Snyk research on ES DSL injection and CVE-2015-1427 (Groovy sandbox escape) spiritually updated for 8.x Painless — abstracted, no vendor code reused
